-Front & rear brake pads replaced
-Front ball bearing upgraded

I am genuinely grateful to Mr. Kaif and Mr. Nadeem for their hard work, honesty, and dedication. They didn’t rush the job at all and made sure everything was done perfectly.

Highly recommended! If you have an Ola scooter, definitely get it serviced or repaired by Mr. Kaif from Bismillah E Bike Repair. Outstanding service right at your doorstep.
